nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_budget
nodes.description: An active-only full-history boundary rank budget. The selected indexed marker and every younger same-axis marker satisfy the same boundary geometry as before, while child-side geometry and uniform opposite-axis extension losses are required only at children with both point capacities positive. The selected normalization premise implies small point capacities, so the checked zero-capacity marker comparison removes inactive children without lowering the bound; all indexed histories and extension counts are preserved. Bounds every fuel approximation and the full original bound, covering both axes, both directions, repeated markers, arbitrary older histories and empty active support. Removes inactive wrong-side children from the geometric obstruction in the singleton-end sandwich estimates.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  (∀ (p j : Nat) (v : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Eq (σ.letterAt p) (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext j v) → instLENat.le 1 j) →
    ∀ (N x : Nat),
      List.instMembership.mem σ.levels N →
        List.instMembership.mem (σ.extPositions N) x →
          ∀ (rightward : Bool),
            (∀ (p : Nat),
                List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
                  And (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit p p)) (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit p p)) →
                    ite (Eq rightward Bool.true) (instLTNat.lt p x) (instLTNat.lt x p)) →
              (∀ (j : Nat),
                  List.instMembership.mem (σ.levelsOn (σ.sideAt N) N) j →
                    ∀ (p : Nat),
                      List.instMembership.mem (σ.extPositions j) p →
                        ite (Eq rightward Bool.true) (instLTNat.lt p x) (instLTNat.lt x p)) →
                ∀ (t : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
                  Ne (σ.sideAt N) t →
                    instLENat.le
                        (instMinNat.min
                          (instHSub.hSub
                            (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_budget.match_1
                              (fun x => Nat) (σ.sideAt N) (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                            1)
                          (instHSub.hSub σ.k (σ.maximumAt N)))
                        3 →
                      ∀ (A B : Nat),
                        (∀ (p : Nat),
                            List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
                              And (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit p p))
                                  (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit p p)) →
                                instLENat.le A (σ.leftExt t 0 p)) →
                          (∀ (p : Nat),
                              List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
                                And (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit p p))
                                    (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit p p)) →
                                  instLENat.le B (σ.rightExt t 0 p)) →
                            have budget :=
                              instHSub.hSub
                                (instHSub.hSub
                                  (instHSub.hSub
                                    (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_budget.match_1
                                      (fun t => Nat) t (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                                    1)
                                  A)
                                B;
                            And
                              (∀ (fuel : Nat),
                                instLENat.le (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context.boundFuel fuel σ) budget)
                              (instLENat.le σ.bound budget)

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_pair_union_bound
nodes.description: Every-fuel and full bound by the exact active opposite ordered-rank-pair union at a boundary marker when the chosen global after absorbing that marker is at most four. Active children and younger chosen markers lie on one side of the indexed marker; inactive children may lie anywhere. Positive labels, arbitrary older history and maxima, either axis and either direction are supported. Retains the existing erasure and opposite-rank transport, applies the unrestricted small-global rank-pair potential, and uses capacity-three inactive pruning. Supplies boundary pair charges for prospective chosen-global-five quadratic and ordered-triple face potentials.

                List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →

              (∀ (j : Nat),
                  List.instMembership.mem (σ.levelsOn (σ.sideAt N) N) j →
                    ∀ (p : Nat),
                      List.instMembership.mem (σ.extPositions j) p →

                    instLENat.le
                        (instMinNat.min
                          (instHSub.hSub
                            (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_pair_union_bound.match_1
                              (fun x => Nat) (σ.sideAt N) (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                            1)
                          (instHSub.hSub σ.k (σ.maximumAt N)))
                        4 →
                      have budget :=
                        instHSub.hSub
                          (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_boundary_marker_rank_pair_union_bound.match_1
                            (fun t => Nat) t (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                          1;
                      have active :=
                        Finset.filter
                          (fun p =>
                            And (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit p p)) (instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit p p)))

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_uniform_rank_exterior_bound
nodes.description: Active-only strict doubled-rank bound for positive-label contexts with chosen global at most four and an actual indexed chosen marker. Chosen capacity at least two and uniform opposite pure extension traces are required only at children whose two point capacities are positive. Every fuel approximation and the full recursive bound are at most twice the resulting common rank-interval cardinality minus one. Inactive children may occur anywhere with arbitrary traces and capacities; older histories, maxima, unbounded exterior sizes and empty active support are allowed. Original-history pruning preserves all indexed data and point capacities, while the actual chosen marker bounds the surviving chosen capacities by two. The checked zero-capacity marker comparison transports the original bound to this pruned context, where the full uniform-source theorem applies. Removes inactive-source restrictions from the uniform-rank capacity-three estimate toward the singleton-end sandwich obstruction.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  (∀ (p j : Nat) (v : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Eq (σ.letterAt p) (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext j v) → instLENat.le 1 j) →
    ∀ (s t : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Ne s t →
        ∀ (N x : Nat),
          List.instMembership.mem σ.levels N →
            Eq (σ.sideAt N) s →
              List.instMembership.mem (σ.extPositions N) x →
                instLENat.le
                    ((fun v =>
                        ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_uniform_rank_exterior_bound.match_1 (fun v => Nat)
                          v (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                      s)
                    4 →
                  ∀ (L R : Nat),
                    (∀ (r : Nat),
                        List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions r →
                          instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit r r) →
                            instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit r r) →
                              instLENat.le 2
                                ((fun v =>
                                    ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_uniform_rank_exterior_bound.match_1
                                      (fun v => Nat) v (fun _ => σ.cupLimit r r) fun _ =>
                                      σ.capLimit r r)
                                  s)) →
                      (∀ (r : Nat),
                          List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions r →
                            instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit r r) →
                              instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit r r) →
                                And (Eq (σ.leftExt t 0 r) L) (Eq (σ.rightExt t 0 r) R)) →
                        have global := fun ρ v =>
                          ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_uniform_rank_exterior_bound.match_1
                            (fun v => Nat) v (fun _ => ρ.u) fun _ => ρ.a;
                        have sourceRanks :=
                          Finset.Icc (instHAdd.hAdd L 1)
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub (global σ t) 1) R);
                        And
                          (∀ (fuel : Nat),
                            instLENat.le (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context.boundFuel fuel σ)
                              (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 sourceRanks.card) 1))
                          (instLENat.le σ.bound
                            (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 sourceRanks.card) 1))

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_unit_axis_three_zone_potential
nodes.description: Three-zone potential for active unit-capacity children when the chosen global parameter is at most four. The left exterior, the entire indexed-marker interior and the right exterior each contribute at most one, so every fuel approximation and the full recursive bound are bounded by the occupied active-zone count and hence by three. The zone potential is additive across arbitrary disjoint kept sets, first on the chosen axis and second on either axis, with arbitrary maxima and no covering requirement. Unit capacity is assumed only at active children. Clear-interval capacity drop handles exterior zones and bracketed-child annihilation merges all interior gaps. Supplies the compressed unit contribution in the singleton-end sandwich rank estimate.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  (∀ (p j : Nat) (v : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Eq (σ.letterAt p) (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext j v) → instLENat.le 1 j) →
    ∀ (s : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      instLENat.le
          (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_unit_axis_three_zone_potential.match_1 (fun s => Nat) s
            (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
          4 →
        (∀ (p : Nat),
            List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
              instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.cupLimit p p) →
                instLTNat.lt 0 (σ.capLimit p p) →
                  instLENat.le
                    (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_active_unit_axis_three_zone_potential.match_1 (fun s => Nat)
                      s (fun _ => σ.cupLimit p p) fun _ => σ.capLimit p p)
                    1) →
          have zones := fun ρ =>
            have markers := (ρ.levelsOn s 0).toFinset.biUnion fun j => (ρ.extPositions j).toFinset;
            have active :=
              Finset.filter
                (fun p => And (instLTNat.lt 0 (ρ.cupLimit p p)) (instLTNat.lt 0 (ρ.capLimit p p)))
                ρ.childPositions.toFinset;
            (Finset.image
                (fun p =>
                  ite (Finset.filter (fun x => instLTNat.lt x p) markers).Nonempty
                    (ite (Finset.filter (fun x => instLTNat.lt p x) markers).Nonempty 1 2) 0)
                active).card;
          And (∀ (fuel : Nat), instLENat.le (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context.boundFuel fuel σ) (zones σ))
            (And (instLENat.le σ.bound (zones σ))
              (And (instLENat.le (zones σ) 3)
                (∀ (keep rest : List Nat) (t : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side) (m n : Nat),
                  (∀ (p : Nat),
                      List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions p →
                        List.instMembership.mem keep p → Not (List.instMembership.mem rest p)) →
                    instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (zones (σ.part keep s m)) (zones (σ.part rest t n)))
                      (zones σ))))

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_actual_marker_companion_maximum_bound
nodes.description: Bound the opposite companion of a context with an actual indexed chosen marker and chosen global at most five by (k-n-1)^2, where n is the new opposite maximum. A retained chosen capacity of at least three sharpens the bound to choose(k-n,2). Erase unselected source levels locally, transport both parts and the retained capacity, and absorb the new opposite maximum while retaining the selected chosen marker and all physical barriers. Positive external labels, distinct axes, an actual indexed chosen marker, chosen global at most five, and retained/removed child witnesses are required. Additional chosen and opposite history, repeated occurrences, old maxima, kept lists and new maxima are arbitrary. No exact-depth, youngest-marker, empty-history, coupling, opposite-global or recursive-potential premise. The triangular conclusion additionally requires retained chosen capacity at least three.
nodes.type_pp:
∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  (∀ (r j : Nat) (v : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Eq (σ.letterAt r) (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.ext j v) → instLENat.le 1 j) →
    ∀ (s t : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Side),
      Ne s t →
        ∀ (N x : Nat),
          List.instMembership.mem σ.levels N →
            Eq (σ.sideAt N) s →
              List.instMembership.mem (σ.extPositions N) x →
                instLENat.le
                    (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_actual_marker_companion_maximum_bound.match_1 (fun s => Nat)
                      s (fun _ => σ.u) fun _ => σ.a)
                    5 →
                  ∀ (keep : List Nat) (m n p q : Nat),
                    List.instMembership.mem (σ.part keep s m).childPositions p →
                      List.instMembership.mem σ.childPositions q →
                        Not (List.instMembership.mem keep q) →
                          have B :=
                            σ.part
                              (List.filter
                                (fun x => Decidable.decide (Not (List.instMembership.mem keep x)))
                                σ.childPositions)
                              t n;
                          have budget := instHSub.hSub (instHSub.hSub σ.k n) 1;
                          And
                            (∀ (fuel : Nat),
                              instLENat.le (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context.boundFuel fuel B)
                                (instHPow.hPow budget 2))
                            (And (instLENat.le B.bound (instHPow.hPow budget 2))
                              (instLENat.le 3
                                  (ErdosSzekeres.ctx_actual_marker_companion_maximum_bound.match_1
                                    (fun s => Nat) s (fun _ => (σ.part keep s m).cupLimit p p)
                                    fun _ => (σ.part keep s m).capLimit p p) →
                                And
                                  (∀ (fuel : Nat),
                                    instLENat.le (ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context.boundFuel fuel B)
                                      ((instHAdd.hAdd budget 1).choose 2))
                                  (instLENat.le B.bound ((instHAdd.hAdd budget 1).choose 2))))

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_actual_marker_large_maximum_straddling_next_band_cut_bound
nodes.description: Remove the youngest-marker and empty-opposite-history restrictions from the straddling extreme cut. Erase all other source levels, using checked erasure monotonicity and local part commutation, then pay the retained unit part and two fixed companion triangular faces. No recursive quadratic or experimental width-product premise. Positive labels, distinct axes, chosen global at most five, and any actual indexed chosen marker at N. Additional chosen and opposite history, repeated markers, maxima and positive unindexed barriers are arbitrary. Opposite global at most k-1; no lower bound on k or opposite width. The chosen kept list is convex in child order and contains source children strictly on both sides of the marker. Chosen new maximum at least k-2; opposite new maximum is arbitrary. No youngest-marker, empty-history, exact-depth, sibling-coupling, singleton-end or recursive-potential premise. Top-band and nonstraddling extreme cuts remain outside this theorem.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_actual_marker_next_band_low_maximum_nonunit_cut_bound
nodes.description: Use the checked sharp arbitrary-history two-marker potential on the chosen part and the companion triangle on the opposite part. For chosen maximum m<=k-6, the resulting sum is below the next-band quadratic target by at least k-6. No stronger saturated two-marker potential is assumed. Small opposite widths are handled locally by the checked small-global rank-region bound. Positive labels, distinct axes, any actual indexed chosen marker and chosen global at most five; arbitrary additional history and repeated markers. Opposite global at most k-1. Positive chosen maximum m<=k-6 and coupling m+n=k-1 imply k>=7 and n>=5. No lower opposite-width assumption. A retained child of chosen capacity at least three and a removed source child; arbitrary kept list. No exact-depth, youngest-marker, empty-history, convexity, singleton-end or recursive-potential premise. Only the next-band quadratic budget is concluded; m=k-5 and the top band remain separate.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_axis_capacity_interval_lower_bound
nodes.description: An endpoint interpolation lower bound for a chosen point capacity: for p<=r<=q, the sum of the two endpoint capacities is at most the middle capacity plus the chosen global parameter minus one. No positivity, child membership, well-formedness, maximum or history restrictions are needed. Greedy extension monotonicity and cutoff inclusion bound the middle pure-chain and sibling-join constraints by the left endpoint constraints plus the right endpoint left extension; positive right capacity pays that extension. At chosen global at most four, two nonunit endpoints therefore force every intermediate chosen point capacity to be positive. Together with the straddling capacity profile, this determines interior capacity exactly one and rules out hidden chosen-axis zero-capacity gaps in the remaining collision source.

The nonmonotone triple forces two chosen chain losses everywhere, placing active intervals in a thin four-rank window; a large chosen maximum then yields 3k-8, or 3k-9 in the next opposite band.
Positive labels, distinct axes, three actual chosen levels in a nonmonotone age/spatial order, chosen global at most five, opposite global at most k, and k at least five.
Empty indexed opposite history and some indexed chosen maximum at least k-4. The selected large level need not be one of the three actual levels and need not have an actual occurrence.
The sharper second conclusion requires opposite global at most k-1. No exact-depth, child pattern or recursive potential premise. The large-maximum and empty-history restrictions remain.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_nonmonotone_triple_saturated_potential_arbitrary_opposite_history
nodes.description: Remove the empty opposite indexed-history restriction from the nonmonotone-triple saturated potential. Retain three actual chosen markers in nonmonotone age/spatial order and a chosen maximum at least k-4 while erasing opposite levels using checked bound monotonicity; the clear-history endpoint is the existing saturated potential. Positive physical labels, distinct axes, chosen global at most five, opposite global at most k, and k at least five remain explicit. Top and next bounds are 3k-8 and 3k-9 for all fuel and the full bound. All additional chosen and opposite history, maxima, inactive children, and positive unindexed barriers are allowed. The large chosen maximum and nonmonotone geometry remain substantive assumptions; this does not close the general parent. Search evidence: runs/sol-trial-20260913/search-arbitrary-opposite.json.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_nonmonotone_triple_small_maxima_counterexample
nodes.description: A well-formed positive-maxima context with three actual chosen markers in nonmonotone order has bound at least eleven, exceeding the proposed top saturation value ten. The chosen global is five, opposite global and k are six, opposite indexed history is empty, and every chosen maximum is one, strictly below k-4. Thus the large-maximum premise cannot simply be dropped from the nonmonotone-triple saturated potential, even for well-formed histories. This certifies a finite-probe witness and rules out that stronger auxiliary potential; it does not refute context additivity or the Erdős–Szekeres conjecture. Probe: runs/sol-trial-20260913/maximum-positive-probe.json; search: runs/sol-trial-20260913/search-maximum-counterexample.json.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_nonunit_children_exterior_of_two_levels
nodes.description: Two actual indexed levels on an axis with global parameter at most four force all nonunit children into one common exterior marker region. For levels N<M witnessed at positions x,y, every child with chosen capacity at least two lies beyond every indexed chosen marker in the direction from x to y. Includes inactive children, arbitrary maxima, unused levels, multiple marker positions at a level, and arbitrary external labels without a positivity premise. Two-step greedy extension witnesses exclude the wrong exterior; one marker on each side excludes the interior. Orients the nonunit rank contribution in the singleton-end sandwich mixed potential.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_nonunit_part_active_companion_cut_potential_bound
nodes.description: Full cut potential bound with a nonunit chosen-part child and an active opposite-axis companion. Under positive labels, chosen global at most four and one actual indexed chosen marker, every pair of independent fuel approximations and the sum of full bounds are bounded by the minimum of the source occupied-unit-zone plus separate nonunit exterior-rank count and twice the all-active opposite-rank union cardinality minus one. Kept lists and new maxima are arbitrary, and the own nonunit witness may be inactive. The raw bound uses the active-companion potential drop; the rank bound combines the two-level own estimate and exact companion rank estimate with either a boundary saving or two distinct reserved endpoints. Discharges nonunit-own, active-companion cuts in the one-level mixed-potential induction toward the singleton-end sandwich proof.

The potential counts occupied active chosen-unit zones plus separate opposite-rank unions of active nonunit children in the left and right chosen exteriors. Requires positive labels, chosen global at most four and one actual indexed chosen marker; kept lists and new maxima are arbitrary, and the own nonunit witness may be inactive. One-marker exterior geometry confines the companion to the opposite old exterior. Converted own-part unit zones reserve distinct endpoint ranks there; companion activity excludes coincident reservations. Supplies the raw-count component of the one-level mixed-potential induction, while the empty-companion case needs common-rank covers.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_nonunit_part_companion_exterior_rank_bound

The nonunit witness may be inactive, and the kept set and two new maxima are arbitrary. The complementary opposite-axis part has every fuel approximation and its full bound controlled by its exact active opposite pure-rank union. Two-level exterior orientation is applied in the chosen part after insertion of the new level; the youngest actual chosen marker supplies the active-boundary rank estimate in the companion. Removes the exterior-companion case from the one-level separate-exterior-rank potential toward the singleton-end sandwich proof.

nodes.name: ErdosSzekeres.ctx_sandwich_middle_block_contraction
nodes.description: Exact middle-block contraction for a three-block partition of a contiguous child run. Replacing the nonempty middle child block by a singleton preserves the parent bound and each part bound, in either orientation at every admissible sibling maximum. The resulting context is well formed with the expected child positions. This reduces the one-singleton-end sandwich family (1,m,r) to (1,1,r), and also applies to arbitrary positive outer block lengths; no child-bound contraction conjecture is used.

∀ (σ : ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Context),
  σ.WellFormed →
    ∀ (b l m r : Nat),
      Eq σ.childPositions (List.range' b (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd l m) r)) →
        instLTNat.lt 0 l →
          instLTNat.lt 0 m →
            instLTNat.lt 0 r →
              have τ :=
                { a := σ.a, u := σ.u, k := σ.k,
                  word :=
                    instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend
                      (instHAppendOfAppend.hAppend (List.take b σ.word)
                        (List.replicate (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd l 1) r)
                          ErdosSzekeres.Ctx.Letter.child))
                      (List.drop (instHAdd.hAdd b (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd l m) r)) σ.word),
                  maxima := σ.maxima };
              And τ.WellFormed
                (And (Eq τ.childPositions (List.range' b (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd l 1) r)))

                                    (List.range' (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b l) m) r))

                                    (List.range' (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b l) 1) r))

nodes.description: Exact ordered-pair saving for two endpoint-clipped overlapping integer intervals. For a<b, the union of ordered pairs from [a,b-1] and [a+1,b] is the ordered-pair set of [a,b] with exactly its extreme corner (a,b) erased. Consequently adding the left triangular charge to this union charge gives the full interval-cardinality square minus one, expressed without subtraction as an equality after adding one. This is the precise one-unit counting saving proposed for an internal interval cut whose complement straddles the chosen pivot. The contextual cut classification remains a separate proof task.

∀ {n k : Nat} {χ : ErdosSzekeres.TripleColoring n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} {q : Fin n},
  instLENat.le 4 k →
    ErdosSzekeres.DecomposableExactUpperAt (instHSub.hSub k 1) →
      ErdosSzekeres.IsSweepRealizable χ →
        ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposableOn χ S →
          Eq S.card (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k 2)) →
            Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem S q) →
              Not (ErdosSzekeres.ContainsStrongPolygonSet χ (Finset.instInsert.insert q S) k) →
                Or
                  (And
                    (Eq (Finset.filter (fun x => instLTFin.lt x q) S).card
                      (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k 3)))
                    (Eq (Finset.filter (fun x => instLTFin.lt q x) S).card
                      (instHPow.hPow 2 (instHSub.hSub k 3))))
                  (Exists fun P =>
                    And (Finset.instHasSubset.Subset P S)
                      (And (Eq P.card (instHSub.hSub k 1))
                        (And (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ P)
                          (And
                            (Or (∀ (x : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem P x → instLTFin.lt x q)
                              (∀ (x : Fin n), SetLike.instMembership.mem P x → instLTFin.lt q x))
                            (Not
                              (ErdosSzekeres.IsStrongPolygonSet χ
                                (Finset.instInsert.insert q P)))))))
